HOW TO PLAY


      
      

         
BASICS & CONTROLS

         
Use the Left / Right Arrows to move pieces side to side.

         
Use the Up Arrow to rotate Clockwise and Z to rotate Counter-Clockwise.

         
Press the Down Arrow to Soft Drop pieces faster.

         
Press Spacebar to Hard Drop a piece instantly.

         
Press C to Hold a piece for later use.

         
(Note: All controls can be changed in the KEYBINDS menu! On a touch device, use the on-screen pad.)

      


      
      

         
SCORING & COMBOS

         
Fill an entire row with blocks to clear it. Clearing multiple lines at once earns you more points and sends Garbage Lines to your opponent!

         
Chain line clears together without dropping a piece that doesn't clear a line to build a COMBO multiplier for huge bonus damage.

         
         

            
COMBO COUNTBONUS GARBAGE DEALT

            
0 - 10 Lines

            
2 - 3+1 Line

            
4 - 5+2 Lines

            
6 - 7+3 Lines

            
8++4 Lines

         

      


      
      

         
SPIN MECHANICS

         
When a piece is twisted into a tight spot right before locking, it performs a SPIN.
These deal extreme damage, equal to clearing double the lines!

         
         
T-SPIN

      


      
      

         
BACK-TO-BACK (B2B)

         
Every Spin or Quad extends your chain and banks damage. A plain Single, Double or Triple releases the whole bank at once. Try it - press the buttons.

GAME MODES

         
ENDLESS: Play forever, aiming for the highest score.

         
ULTRA: Clear 40 lines as fast as possible.

         
SURVIVAL: Survive an endless, incoming rain of garbage blocks.

         
PUZZLES: Use the exact pieces given to fully clear the board.

         
VS BOT: Battle an AI opponent. Send them garbage lines to knock them out!

         
ENDURANCE: Fight bots back to back. Each wave the bot gets harder!

         
PUYO PUYO (BETA): A different game entirely - match colored pairs to chain up your score. See the next page.

      


      
      

         
OVERTIME

         
In VS and Spectate, a match that runs long stops rewarding patience. Every clear's garbage damage is multiplied the longer the clock runs - so stalling for a perfect board eventually costs you more than it earns.

         

            
0:00 - 0:59Normal damage

            
1:00Garbage x1.5

            
1:30Garbage x2

            
2:00Garbage x3

         

         
You will not miss it: the timer changes colour, an indicator appears under your HOLD panel, and the edges of the screen catch fire in the same colour as the current tier - with a whoosh the instant it ignites and every time it escalates.

      


      
      

         
PUYO PUYO (BETA)

         
A different puzzle entirely from the rest of the modes - colored pairs drop onto a 6x12 board instead of tetrominoes. There is no hold, no hard drop, and no line clears here.

         
MATCH FOUR or more of the same color touching side to side or top to bottom and they pop. If puyos fall into place and complete another group right after, that is a CHAIN - each link is worth dramatically more than the last, so a slow, deliberate setup can outscore a dozen lucky pops.

         
Controls reuse your normal binds: move and rotate the same way as the other modes. There is no hard drop - holding SPACE just falls a lot faster, so you can still slide the pair into place on the way down.

         
This mode is a first pass and will keep changing - board size, drop speed and scoring are all still being tuned.

      


      
      

         
SURVIVAL & ICY MOUNTAIN

         
Garbage never stops coming, and it only gets heavier. Every 10 lines you clear advances you a WAVE - both the size and the frequency of incoming garbage climb with it, maturing into a real storm by around wave 12 and staying brutal from there on.

Wave → garbage pressure

         

         
V2 BETA - ICY MOUNTAIN: the same survival, reframed as an infinite climb up a mountain riding a rocket. Line clears push your altitude meter up (a bigger clear is worth more), and the higher wave you reach, the harsher the blizzard around you gets.

         

            
300mDecent

            
600mGreat

            
900mExcellent

            
1200mLegendary

         

      


      
      

         
BOSS (V2 BETA)

         
A single fight against THE SENTINEL - 100 HP, shown as a health bar under your own board instead of a second playfield. It never takes or queues garbage - every point of damage your clears work out to comes straight off its health instead.

         
Watch the countdown ring under the health bar - it tells you exactly when THE SENTINEL swings next, the same "see it coming" idea as Survival's own garbage dial.

         

            
Garbage dropA small hit, similar to Survival

            
Heavy assaultA much bigger garbage dump

            
Board flipYour whole board turns upside down

            
Laser sweepA blinding beam crosses the board

            
BlackoutBoard turns fully black for 8 pieces

            
Cursed piecesNext 5 pieces gain a welded extra cell

            
BombNext piece blasts a crater wherever it lands

         

         
Pull off a TETRIS and real laser bolts fire from your board straight at it - Boss mode's own special-case clear animation, on top of the usual damage. Beat it to 0 HP for BOSS DEFEATED; top out first and THE SENTINEL wins instead.

         
EASY/NORMAL/HARD only change how often and how hard it swings - HARD barely gives you a breath between attacks, by design.

      


      
      

         
GARBAGE CHART

         
How many lines a clear sends, by what you cleared (rows) and combo depth (columns) - column 0 is a fresh clear with no combo going yet. B2B rows already include the back-to-back bonus; ALL CLEAR always sends a flat 10 on top of its own clear, no matter the combo.

Pick a profile to load it instantly. Tweak the sliders below, then pick CUSTOM 1/2/3 and hit SAVE to keep them. RESET always puts DAS/ARR/SDF/DCD back to this game's original pre-HANDLING-tab feel.

          


          

            DAS (ms)
            

              

                
                

              

              367ms
            

            
Delayed Auto Shift - how long you hold a direction before it starts repeating on its own.

          


          

            ARR (ms)
            

              

                
                

              

              33ms
            

            
Auto Repeat Rate - how fast it keeps repeating after that. 0 = as fast as possible.

          


          

            SDF
            

              

                
                

              

              20
            

            
Soft Drop Factor - how many times faster soft drop falls than normal gravity. Max (∞) slams straight to the floor the instant you hold down.

          


          

            DCD (ms)
            

              

                
                

              

              0ms
            

            
DAS Cut Delay - how long after letting go before DAS can charge again on your next press.
